evidence_quote: an investigation later showed the reports to be false
rationale: The evidence explicitly states that the former secretary general of the International Olympic Committee denied that the IOC had secretly negotiated a sponsorship deal with a fast-food chain in 2005, and further notes that "an investigation later showed the reports to be false." This directly contradicts the claim that such a deal was negotiated.
review_note: Investigation supplies factual falsification, not just denial.
